blocks.text:
The main focus of this trip is exploring Antarctica from the water and ashore. You sail among icebergs and glaciers, take Zodiac excursions and watch penguins, seals, whales and seabirds. In summer, animals gather in particularly large numbers along the Antarctic Peninsula to breed and feed.

The scenery changes gradually along the route: sheltered bays and the Beagle Channel, open waters near Cape Horn, the Drake Passage crossing, then ice, fjords, snow-covered peaks and the Antarctic coast.
